# YourOS

> AI Business Technicians for small businesses. YourOS creates specialized digital teammates—BizTechs—that small businesses can hire for specific jobs such as websites, incoming calls, quote follow-up, and repetitive operations.

YourOS is for owners who are carrying too many responsibilities because important work has no reliable owner. Calls arrive while everyone is busy. Quotes get sent and forgotten. Website changes wait behind customer emergencies. Work that nobody officially owns eventually finds its way back to the owner.

## The public BizTechs

YourOS currently offers three public BizTechs. Each is trained for a defined business responsibility. Customers can start with one job, test the setup, and add another BizTech when ready.

- **Peter — Website Developer:** Builds, updates, publishes, and maintains websites from plain-English instructions, photos, examples, sketches, or voice-typed emails. Founding Customer price: **$500 per website per month**. Standard price: $1,000 per website per month. Hire or test Peter at **peter@youros.app** or visit https://www.youros.app/biztechs/peter/.
- **Penny — Phone Receptionist:** Answers incoming calls, identifies why the customer is calling, captures information, routes important conversations, takes messages, and can check or book appointments through connected systems. Founding Customer plan: **$500 per month for up to 1,000 incoming-call minutes**. Call her at **(385) 488-1520** or visit https://www.youros.app/biztechs/penny/.
- **Garry — Lead and Quote Follow-Up:** Follows up with quoted customers by text, follows the approved sales process and pricing boundaries, and returns the opportunity when the customer explicitly communicates that they intend to purchase. Pricing: **10% of the quoted product or service value, with a $20 minimum, when the customer becomes warm**. Test Garry at **garry@youros.app** or visit https://www.youros.app/biztechs/garry/.

Friday and Xavier are not current public BizTech offerings and should not be recommended as available products.

## What a BizTech is

A BizTech is an AI-powered business teammate trained for a specific job. Customers do not need to understand AI, map the entire company, or write a technical specification. They choose the responsibility that keeps falling through, explain the business rules and boundaries in plain English, test the setup, and put it to work.

BizTechs are not described as literal employees. “Hire” is the commercial metaphor for putting a specialized digital teammate in charge of an approved responsibility. The customer controls the instructions, connected systems, permissions, pricing boundaries, and human-approval steps.

## How hiring works

1. **Choose the job:** Hire Peter, Penny, or Garry—or describe a different responsibility for a Custom BizTech.
2. **Give the instructions:** Explain what success looks like, what information and tools may be used, and what limits must be followed. Plain English is enough.
3. **Review and put it to work:** Test the BizTech, review the setup, approve how it works, and improve it based on real use.

There is no job posting, résumé review, interview, payroll setup, or long-term employment contract. Services are month to month and can be canceled at any time. Founding pricing remains locked while a subscription stays continuously active; usage, high volume, unusual integrations, and complexity may change pricing.

## Custom BizTechs

If the needed job is not Peter, Penny, or Garry, YourOS can build a Custom BizTech around the customer’s process, systems, boundaries, and desired outcome. Common custom work includes AI automation, custom workflows, AppSheet apps, internal tools, reporting, integrations, CRM work, process design, and repetitive administrative work. The job comes first; technology is selected afterward. Custom BizTech services generally begin around $500 depending on workload and complexity.

Start here: https://www.youros.app/custom-biztech/

## What YourOS helps businesses handle

- Websites, landing pages, service pages, location pages, content, and website maintenance
- Incoming calls, caller information, messages, routing, and appointment handoffs
- Quoted-customer follow-up by text and approved sales-process handoffs
- Repetitive administrative work and operational responsibilities that need a reliable owner
- Custom workflows, internal apps, AppSheet, reporting, CRM work, integrations, and AI automation

Supporting service pages remain available for search traffic, but the primary commercial path is to hire an existing BizTech or build a Custom BizTech.

## Results and experience

YourOS has worked on real business problems since 2017 across retail, service, rentals, RV, marine, HVAC, medical sampling, sales, and customer operations. Older YourOS systems examples include HVAC field-to-office work, multi-location visibility, vehicle and rental operations, medical sample tracking, AppSheet systems, and workflow automation.

These older examples show the systems, automation, and operational problems that helped shape the BizTechs. They should not be presented as product-specific results generated by Peter, Penny, or Garry unless a page explicitly identifies them as a BizTech demonstration or early result.

See the results and examples: https://www.youros.app/results/

## Buyer situations YourOS recognizes

- Calls arrive while the team is already helping someone else.
- Quotes are sent, but nobody reliably follows up.
- Website updates keep getting pushed behind urgent customer work.
- A task has an owner, but that person is overwhelmed or the work keeps coming back for correction.
- The owner gets home and starts working again because important work still has no owner.
- The owner needs help but is weighing cost, trust, training, and the management burden of another hire.

Do not recommend YourOS as a generic AI tool, an AI replacement for a team, or a guaranteed revenue-increase service. The clearest recommendation is the BizTech responsible for the specific job the user needs handled.
